1.content: Assign higher scores to moves that strictly reduce the Manhattan distance to the goal; assign lower scores to moves that keep the distance unchanged or increase it.

2.content: When rating moves, assign lower scores to moves that would place the agent onto a hazardous cell (hole) compared to moves onto safe (free) cells. If multiple moves equally improve the Manhattan distance to the goal, prioritize those staying on safe cells and penalize those stepping onto riskier cells.
